# Add auto-generated __repr__ support to @c_class and field() in Python dataclass system

## TL;DR
- `c_class(type_key, repr=True)` now generates a `__repr__` method automatically (default on, skipped if user defines own `__repr__`).
- `field(repr=True)` controls whether a field appears in the generated repr; `Field.__slots__` gains `repr`.
- `method_repr()` in `_utils.py` produces exec-based codegen: `ClassName(field1=value1, ...)` using `!r` format; collects fields from full type hierarchy via new `_get_all_fields()` helper.
- `_add_method` now always writes to `attrs` (removes the "already defined" guard) so base-class methods like `Object.__repr__` can be properly overridden.

## Key Exports

```python
# python/tvm_ffi/dataclasses/field.py
class Field:
    """Dataclass field descriptor for @c_class."""
    name: str | None
    default_factory: Callable | MISSING_TYPE
    init: bool
    repr: bool  # NEW — controls inclusion in __repr__

def field(
    default=MISSING,
    default_factory=MISSING,
    init: bool = True,
    repr: bool = True,  # NEW
) -> _FieldValue: ...
# Interacts with: c_class decorator, method_repr(), method_init()

# python/tvm_ffi/dataclasses/c_class.py
def c_class(
    type_key: str,
    init: bool = True,
    repr: bool = True,  # NEW
) -> Callable[[Type[T]], Type[T]]: ...
# Interacts with: _utils.method_repr(), _utils.type_info_to_cls(), TypeInfo registry

# python/tvm_ffi/dataclasses/_utils.py
def _get_all_fields(type_info: TypeInfo) -> list[TypeField]: ...
# Collects fields bottom-up through parent chain; result is parent→child order
# Interacts with: TypeInfo.parent_type_info, TypeInfo.fields

def method_repr(type_cls: type, type_info: TypeInfo) -> Callable[..., str]:
    """Generate __repr__ via exec-based codegen."""
    # Produces: def __repr__(self) -> str: return f'ClassName(f1={self.f1!r}, ...)'
    # Invariant: only fields with dataclass_field.repr=True are included
    # Interacts with: _get_all_fields(), TypeField.dataclass_field.repr, exec()
```

## Impact
- API: `c_class()` and `field()` gain optional `repr: bool` parameters (backward-compatible, default `True`).
- Behavioral: `@c_class` objects now print as `ClassName(field=value, ...)` instead of the default `<object at 0xADDR>` repr. Classes with `Object.__repr__` defined are now properly overridden.
- Flags/config: none
- Data formats/schemas: none

## Usage Examples

```python
from tvm_ffi.dataclasses import c_class, field

@c_class("my.Node")
class Node:
    name: str
    value: int = field(default=0)
    _internal: str = field(repr=False)  # excluded from repr

n = Node(name="x", value=42, _internal="hidden")
print(n)  # Node(name='x', value=42)

# Opt out repr entirely:
@c_class("my.Token", repr=False)
class Token:
    id: int
```
